description: No acknowledgement arrives for a DATA-ONLY: when dts.ack_wait expires the D_PDU is taken to have failed and is retransmitted at the next transmission.
note: Link setup as cas/make-caller-accepted: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ, its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 makes the CAS call the peer (Ed4 request out at 75000, sent at 80550), and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link with the 16-bit family (B-0219, B-0142): window edges TX LWE 0, TX UWE 65535, RX LWE 0, RX UWE 65535 (C-0782, C-0787). The held U_PDU goes down as an ARQ C_PDU (A-0194) and dts.ttd runs to its TTD (C-1050). The burst ends at 92000 with the EOT prediction at 96000 ahead and data queued: csma.vdcd_end; at 96000 LBT rule 1 (the burst was addressed only to us, K-0067) and contention, 12000 ms (second draw). At 108000 the C_PDU goes as one DATA-ONLY, FSN 0 (as dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip); at 118350 dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts with dts.ack_wait_ms. Nothing is heard from the peer. The standard leaves the choice between retransmitting and waiting to the node (C-0906, C-0911); we retransmit when dts.ack_wait expires (C-1120). At 178350 FSN 0 is failed and owed a retransmission, so the queue is no longer empty: the MAC leaves SENSE with LBT rule 3, since our own transmission was the last and counts as VDCD-determined (K-0071, K-0074), csma.lbt_wait 3000; at 181350 contention, 45000 ms (third draw, K-0080). At 226350 the same DATA-ONLY goes again, byte for byte (FSN 0, both TX WIN flags, EOT 20), ending at 236700, when dts.ack_wait starts again. At 246000 RX LWE 1 acknowledges it: dts.ack_wait stops, the C_PDU is confirmed (C-0679, C-1130) and dts.ttd is cancelled. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Fill (C-1154): each 29-byte DATA-ONLY transmission leaves 21 bytes of its second block; no acknowledgement goes in it and its only addressee, 0.0.1.3, is recorded Ed4 (C-0050), so one PADDING D_PDU (11 bytes, EOT 10) follows the DATA-ONLY (C-0367, C-0887) and 10 bytes are zero filled.  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
